name: Pod arkoj enigmy
source:
An unsociable detective of the Police Department leads a quiet, uneventful life in a sleepy southern town. But everything changes when his superior assigns him to the case of two missing young people — a search that soon spirals into an inexplicable nightmare full of strange fads. Because the person who reported the disappearance... doesn’t exist in any conventional sense of the word.

Aenigmarch is a visual kinetic novel in the genre of a mystical thriller with elements of surrealism.
translation:
一位性格孤僻的警察局侦探在一个沉睡的南方小镇过着平静、平静的生活。但当他的上级指派他处理两名失踪年轻人的案件时，一切都发生了变化——这次搜寻很快就陷入了一场充满奇怪时尚的莫名噩梦。因为报告失踪事件的人……在任何传统意义上都不存在。

《Aenigmarch》是一部带有超现实主义元素的神秘惊悚小说类型的视觉动力小说。
